planets.name: TOI-620 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-620 with a 5.1-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-620 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-620. Its orbit and size follow Reefe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
